instruction: Fix `base64_decode` so it decodes the bytes back to a UTF-8 string (the current code returns raw bytes).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/codec.py b/codec.py
--- a/codec.py
+++ b/codec.py
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
 
 def base64_decode(text):
     """Base64-decode ASCII text back into a UTF-8 string."""
-    return base64.b64decode(text)
+    return base64.b64decode(text).decode("utf-8")
